meta.name: accessibility-testing
meta.description: Test web applications for WCAG compliance and ensure usability for users with disabilities. Use for accessibility test, a11y, axe, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, and WCAG validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Test web accessibility compliance and ensure usability for all users

howto.what: 当您请求进行网页无障碍测试时，Claude 能根据要求生成使用 axe-core 和 Playwright 的测试代码，检查 WCAG 合规性，并提供键盘导航、ARIA 等参考指南。
howto.when: 当您提到“无障碍测试”、“a11y”、“WCAG”等关键词，或要求进行键盘导航、屏幕阅读器兼容性检查时触发。

howto.what_en: When you request web accessibility testing, Claude can generate test code using axe-core and Playwright to check WCAG compliance and provide reference guides for keyboard navigation, ARIA, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like accessibility testing, a11y, WCAG, or request keyboard navigation or screen reader compatibility checks.
